selection: First two final cases in the frozen order, first five actual referee replies per case, all three arms; 30 fixed items, no output-dependent replacement.
reviewer: Execution-team AI; source-based interpretation after outcomes were frozen, not independent human gold.

definitions.source_supported: Actual referee answer is supported or its Unknown appropriately preserves unspecified detail.
definitions.source_contradicted: Actual answer conflicts with explicit source facts.
definitions.source_unresolved: Question ambiguity or missing details prevent a grounded categorical judgment; not counted as a measured referee error.

limitations: This supplementary AI review does not qualify the referee or establish a population error rate.
Unresolved items are not measured referee errors; the small fixed subset is not a random sample.
No scores, prompts or model outputs were corrected after inspection.
The original mechanical audit retained its then-pending review status and remains unchanged.
Only aggregate counts are exported; raw review rows and source texts remain private.
